en-US.description: A lightweight Windows launcher that searches and starts apps with a hotkey, including pinyin search.
en-US.longDescription: Kite is a lightweight application launcher for Windows, built as a native desktop app with Rust and Iced — no WebView2 or Node.js required. A global hotkey brings up a search window where typing an app name, alias, or pinyin quickly filters and launches the target. It scans the Start Menu, desktop, registry App Paths, and Windows packaged apps, and offers launch history, pinned results, a system tray, and optional Everything file search.

zh-CN.description: 按下快捷键即可快速搜索并启动应用的 Windows 轻量启动器，支持拼音搜索。
zh-CN.longDescription: Kite 是一款面向 Windows 的轻量应用启动器，使用 Rust 和 Iced 构建原生桌面应用，无需 WebView2 或 Node.js。通过全局快捷键唤起搜索窗口，输入应用名称、别名或拼音即可快速筛选并启动目标程序；支持扫描开始菜单、桌面、注册表 App Paths 和 Windows 打包应用，提供启动历史、固定结果、系统托盘以及可选的 Everything 文件搜索。
zh-CN.name: Kite
